text:
Four sensors, covering five source datasets, were checked for fire detections on ASSET-F03 from 2026-10-04 to 2026-11-03:

- VIIRS on Suomi NPP (VIIRS_SNPP)
- VIIRS on NOAA-20
- VIIRS on NOAA-21
- MODIS

All were covered for every day of the period. Each sensor's coverage is listed as "covered" through 2026-11-03. VIIRS_SNPP is listed in two consecutive segments, with the split at 2026-11-02.

None of them recorded a thermal detection intersecting the asset (count 0), so the assessment is "not detected."

This doesn't prove no fire occurred. Small, short-lived, cool, or cloud-obscured fires may be missed. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change, or dates outside this period. Detections are 375 m for VIIRS and 1 km for MODIS.
